Great to meet you and Ben on the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side: we heard that Summit Retail is evaluating Redwood to standardize inference for recommendation and search features across web and mobile, with two main priorities: reducing per-request latency under 120ms p50 and cutting inference unit costs by ~30%.

What would help us move to a clean technical + procurement conversation is a short stakeholder map and the expected procurement path. Specifically: 
- Who is the economic buyer for this initiative (title and best email)?
- Who owns security/compliance sign-off (SOC 2 / data residency)?
- Procurement contact and any standard procurement timelines (PO + SOW cadence)?
- Any decision criteria beyond latency & cost (ML quality/regression tolerance, vendor lock-in concerns, contractual terms)?

If you can share a quick org chart (or just a list of names/titles) and the procurement contact, we’ll align our technical team and get you a tailored mutual action plan. I’m copying Neha (Customer Success) to help with onboarding questions and next-step timelines.

1) You share org chart / procurement contact (if available)
2) I’ll intro Rishi (SE) to run a short technical walk-through and map compatibility with your infra
3) We’ll prepare a mutual action plan with timelines for security review and procurement items

Thanks again  appreciate the time today.

Best,
